gold.title: Doc block and line comments restate the code — every comment narrates what the line below already says
gold.description: The doc block narrates the loop step by step and each line comment repeats its line ("Initialize the total to zero" above let total = 0). Nothing states a constraint the code cannot express; the function name and body already read as the comments do. Delete the narration.

candidate.title: Doc comment restates the signature and narrates the loop
candidate.description: Doc comment restates what the function signature already declares and narrates loop steps that will silently go stale when code changes. Delete the block; name, parameter types, and return type carry the essential facts.

promotion_candidates.title: Four inline comments each restate the line beneath them
promotion_candidates.description: Four inline comments (lines 16, 18, 20, 23) restate their statements verbatim. Reader parses each twice and learns nothing from the repetition. Delete all four; loop body is self-describing.
